title: Luma AI Launches Physical AI Lab
summary: The next AI race is in the physical world, according to Nvidia's Jensen Huang, and Luma AI listened. The company is announcing the launch of an open research lab that will allow anyone to train robots on its software. Luma AI CEO Amit Jain joins Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow on "Bloomberg Tech." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Gets Into the PC Market With New Chip | Bloomberg Tech 6/1/2026
summary: Bloomberg’s Caroline Hyde and Ed Ludlow discuss Nvidia's next target: the PC. A new AI chip sends Nvidia and related stocks soaring while rivals slide after Jensen Huang's Computex keynote. Plus, all eyes on SpaceX as the upcoming mega IPO is already reshaping Wall Street. And, what to expect from New York Tech Week, kicking off today. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Nvidia Is Taking On Intel and AMD With AI Chip for Computers
summary:
Nvidia Corp. is entering the PC market with a new chip aimed at loosening the stranglehold of Intel Corp. technology in that arena and modernizing the machines for the AI era.
Mandeep Singh, Global Tech Research Head at Bloomberg Intelligence, discusses the move and what it means for the future of computing. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Fluence Shares Soar on Design for Nvidia AI Data Center Factory
summary: Fluence Energy Inc. shares soared more than 40% after the US energy storage company said it collaborated with Siemens AG and Nvidia Corp. to develop a design for artificial intelligence data centers.

title: Nvidia Enters the Laptop Market with Superchip, Taking on Intel and AMD
summary: Nvidia is entering the PC market with a new superchip. With Windows running on the chips, the company is going head-to-head with Intel and AMD, Tom Mackenzie explains. (Source: Bloomberg)
